مُمَانِحٌ (S, K) and ↓ مَنُوحٌ (S) (tropical:) A she-camel whose milk remains, (K,) or that yields plenty of milk in the winter, (S,) after the milk of the other camels has passed away; (S, K;) like مُجَالِحٌ. (S.) You say also ↓ نُوقٌ مَمَانِحُ [app. pl. of مِمْنَحٌ, which is perhaps not used. (TA.) ―
-b2- Also the former, (tropical:) Rain that does not cease: (K:) and (tropical:) wind of which the rain does not cease. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
